headline: 10 units deployed as fire rages in Chawkbazar building
summary: A fire broke out at the Munsur Khan Plaza in Old Dhaka, with firefighters struggling to control the flames due to narrow lanes and water shortages.
details: A massive fire broke out at the Munsur Khan Plaza, a multi-story building in the Chotokatara area of Chawkbazar, Old Dhaka, on Monday afternoon.
The blaze started at a shop on the sixth floor of the building at approximately 5:02 PM. Firefighters were alerted and first arrived at the scene by 5:22 PM.
Currently, 10 units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence headquarters and Lalbagh fire station are working together to bring the flames under control.
Firefighters are facing significant challenges due to the congested nature of the area, narrow lanes, and a lack of natural or permanent water sources nearby.
Rescue workers are relying on water-carrying vehicles and extending hose pipes from a distance to combat the fire.
No reports of casualties or the exact cause of the fire have been released yet.
caption:
10 fire units are battling a massive blaze in Old Dhaka's Chawkbazar. Narrow lanes and water shortages are hindering the rescue efforts.

A massive fire broke out at the Munsur Khan Plaza, a multi-story building in the Chotokatara area of Chawkbazar, Old Dhaka, on Monday afternoon.

The blaze started at a shop on the sixth floor of the building at approximately 5:02 PM. Firefighters were alerted and first arrived at the scene by 5:22 PM.

Currently, 10 units from the Fire Service and Civil Defence headquarters and Lalbagh fire station are working together to bring the flames under control.

Firefighters are facing significant challenges due to the congested nature of the area, narrow lanes, and a lack of natural or permanent water sources nearby.

Rescue workers are relying on water-carrying vehicles and extending hose pipes from a distance to combat the fire.

No reports of casualties or the exact cause of the fire have been released yet.
